remarks: Welcome Home! This tri-level townhome has been freshly painted and beautifully maintained. The main level features an eat in kitchen, half bath, and spacious sun filled living room. Door off the living room provide access to a backyard space- perfect for grilling. The upper level features two bedrooms with large closets, and a full bath. Over 500 sq feet of basement space for laundry room, storage, and exercise equipment. Two assigned tandem parking spaces, and visitor parking. Minutes from I95, the Merritt Parkway, public transportation, restaurants and shopping.Highest and Best offers due by Tuesday 8/6 at 12pm.
